scientific_integrity: The sharp three-dimensional coefficient-body volume and polynomial entropy exponent were known for the linear Jordan map. The claim is the nonlinear, irrational-base, center-uniform robustness theorem. The supporting verification is an analytic proof and finite diagnostics, not external certification.
scientific_limitations: The map uses one irrational base rotation, one periodic C1 skew function, the max circular-coordinate metric and a sufficient small-radius bound. No universal rate is asserted. General nonlinear towers are not classified and historical priority awaits independent validation.
title: A universal sharp Bowen-ball volume for nonlinear three-dimensional skew towers
